method: Read-only static PE parser based on Microsoft PE/COFF specification; no target image loaded or executed.

files.limitations: Static headers and ordinary import table only. Dynamic/delay imports, protected code, runtime calls and protocols were not analyzed. Entropy does not prove encryption or packing.
